title: When a hot cache entry expires, the database gets mobbed
body: While a popular key is cached, thousands of requests are harmless; the moment it expires, all of them may stampede the database to recompute it at once. This thundering herd has flattened systems whose steady state was comfortable. Fixes are unglamorous: request coalescing, early refresh, jittered TTLs, or letting one worker rebuild while others serve slightly stale.
